item.title: European allies take over NATO joint force commands
item.description: NATO has agreed a shake-up of its command, with the UK set to take over Joint Force Command Norfolk, Italy to lead JFC Naples, and Germany and Poland to rotate command of JFC Brunssum, while the US retains MARCOM, AIRCOM and LANDCOM. The post European allies take over NATO joint force commands first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO response will be ‘devastating’ if attacked
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has warned that any attack on the Alliance would be met with a devastating response. The post NATO response will be ‘devastating’ if attacked first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ukraine defences unlikely to collapse this year say NATO
item.description: Russia is continuing to make incremental gains on parts of the front line but remains short of the conditions needed for a breakthrough, with Ukrainian defences unlikely to collapse this year, a senior NATO official told journalists. The post Ukraine defences unlikely to collapse this year say NATO first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO launches Arctic Sentry to tighten grip on High North
item.description: NATO has launched a new enhanced vigilance activity in the Arctic and High North, warning the region is increasingly becoming a front line of strategic competition. The post NATO launches Arctic Sentry to tighten grip on High North first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO says 24-month rapid tech adoption target is achievable
item.description: NATO says its Rapid Adoption Action Plan can bring new tech into service within 24 months, and told the UK Defence Journal the target is realistic, with some off-the-shelf systems acquired in as little as six to nine months. The post NATO says 24-month rapid tech adoption target is achievable first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK carrier drone plan moves on without catapults
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that Royal Navy programmes Project VIXEN and Project ARK ROYAL are no longer in use, with both efforts now absorbed into a broader Maritime Aviation Transformation Strategy. The post UK carrier drone plan moves on without catapults first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Reeves urges Europe to widen joint defence procurement
item.description: Chancellor Rachel Reeves has called for closer defence and industrial cooperation with Europe, urging allies to pursue joint procurement and deeper interoperability as a way to deliver better value for money and accelerate capability delivery. item.title: Army fast-tracks drones and loitering munitions via Rapstone
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has outlined a broad package of new battlefield capabilities being accelerated into service through Task Force Rapstone. The post Army fast-tracks drones and loitering munitions via Rapstone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rutte urges rapid air defence build-up across NATO
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has warned that the Alliance must urgently accelerate production of air defence systems and ammunition, as Defence Ministers prepare to meet in Brussels. The post Rutte urges rapid air defence build-up across NATO first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MoD promises faster recruitment with job offers in 10 days
item.description: The government is working towards: "delivering the ambition to make a conditional offer of employment to candidates within 10 days, and a provisional training start date within 30 days". The post MoD promises faster recruitment with job offers in 10 days first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
